# Migrating to App Stylr v0.5.0

`v0.5.0` adds an optional Game Interface profile for browser games. It introduces reusable sizing tokens and guidance for canvas-first layouts, floating control rails, progressive disclosures, gameplay-world color exceptions, responsive behavior, and game-interface QA.

Utility apps do not change appearance when moving from `v0.4.0` to `v0.5.0`.

## Browser games

1. Pin the game to `v0.5.0` and refresh the generated CSS and font adapters.
2. Review [`docs/games.md`](../games.md) and the rendered App Stylr Visual Reference.
3. Replace local game-interface sizing values with the generated `--profile-game-*` values where they describe the same role.
4. Keep game-specific layouts and mechanics local. The profile does not provide a shared component library.
5. Verify every menu state at the game’s normal desktop size and declared minimum supported width.
6. Record gameplay-world colors and any product-specific chrome differences in the consumer’s App Stylr exceptions file.

## Other consumers

Existing utility, native, and extension consumers may update their version pin without adopting the Game Interface profile. Their semantic tokens and existing component recipes are unchanged.
